Why some dates remain unknown

Google’s policy uses first US Google Store availability as its anchor. The initial dataset has not verified the precise availability dates, so it does not calculate an expiry. A fixed future end date for the listed iPhones and Galaxy S25 has not been recorded here. This is a dataset gap, not a claim that those devices receive no updates.

Installed versions and rollout status are not tracked. Check the device’s settings and the manufacturer’s update instructions for your region. A later purchase does not restart a policy window.
